consensus_summary: Primary meaning is the gospel/kingdom as instrument of evangelistic gathering of people (fishers of men; dragnet parable gathering every kind for later separation). Common alternatives are snare/trap of the wicked and instrument of divine judgment; minority readings include church unity or oppressive conquest.
book_summary: Enclosure by which a power takes the living from the sea of peoples (every kind, alive) for harvest sorting into vessels or furnace, never ransomed; armies are God's net, gospel the kingdom's, wicked hide theirs (and are caught); Hebrew equates dragnet with the devoted thing (wholly consecrated or destroyed).
consensus_core_identification: Net as gospel/kingdom gathering instrument (evangelism and dragnet ingathering pending judgment).
book_core_identification: Net as any power's enclosure taking living from sea of peoples for irrevocable harvest sorting (vessels/furnace); gospel, armies, and wicked snares as instances; linked to herem devotion.
boundary_disagreement: Book unifies consensus primary (kingdom/gospel net) with its common alternatives (divine judgment nets; wicked snares) under one core, adds armies-as-God's-net and herem/never-ransomed conditions, and does not privilege the fishers-of-men call narratives.
rationale: Cores share the Matt 13 referent of a net gathering every kind from the sea for sorting, so the general category is preserved rather than replaced; the book materially broadens and re-precisifies by treating gospel, armies, and hidden snares as coordinate instances of the same enclosure-for-irrevocable-devotion, plus the Hebrew dragnet/herem link. This changes extension and boundaries without contradicting the shared sorting image, yielding REFINED (not MATCH, not DIVERGENT).
strongest_objection: Consensus privileges the NT fishers-of-men evangelistic call as primary, which the entry's citations and wording de-emphasize in favor of a judgment/devotion unification that may over-assimilate distinct metaphors.
